variants.specifics: Ossian at the Drowned Lantern, Dunstan the smith, Mabry's potions and books; bandits on the north road keep trade thin.

inn.speaker: Ossian
inn.text: Welcome to the Drowned Lantern, stranger! With Corwin's lot on the north road, you'll have a bed all to yourself tonight!

arms.speaker: Dunstan
arms.text: Dunstan's forge! Swords, shields, good mail -- all made right here. Nobody's bought a blade in a month. Will you be the first?

magic.speaker: Mabry
magic.text: Oh! A customer! Come in, come in! Potions, scrolls and spell books, and nobody to buy them since the bandits came.

variants.specifics: Tilda at the Miller's Rest, Bram the smith, Old Nell the potion-seller; wolves from the Ashwood scare the carters off.

inn.speaker: Tilda
inn.text: Come in, lad! The Miller's Rest has hot stew and warm beds. The wolves scare the carters off, so take your pick!

arms.speaker: Bram
arms.text: Bram's the name, and iron's the trade! Wolves in the Ashwood, friend -- you'll want a good shield before you go near them.

magic.speaker: Nell
magic.text: Hmmm. A new face. Old Nell has potions for bites and scrolls for the dark. Buy something, dearie -- the wolves never do!

variants.specifics: Ossian at the Drowned Lantern, Hobb the armourer by the Moot Hall, Mabry; the Reeve's shut north gate stops the carts.

inn.speaker: Ossian
inn.text: Ah, a guest! The Reeve shut the north gate, and now nobody stops at the Drowned Lantern but the rats. Ale, stranger?

arms.speaker: Hobb
arms.text: This is Hobb's. Armour, blades, shields. Gate's shut, carts don't come, prices go up. Buy now or pay more tomorrow!

magic.speaker: Mabry
magic.text: Welcome, kind stranger! I've potions for every ache, and scrolls besides. Trade's slow with the gate shut -- I'll make you a fair price!

variants.specifics: Gertrude at the Ferryman's Rope, Dunstan, Elspeth the herb-wife; the Urchins from the barrow steal from every stall.

inn.speaker: Gertrude
inn.text: Welcome to the Ferryman's Rope! Mind your boots by the door -- the Urchins from the barrow will have them off you!

arms.speaker: Dunstan
arms.text: Shields and swords, fresh from the anvil! Those Urchins east of the ford stole half my nails. Buy something before they take the rest!

magic.speaker: Elspeth
magic.text: Potions, scrolls, books of spells! Elspeth's wares are the best this side of the Bracken. Well... the only ones, anyway!

variants.specifics: Ossian, Dunstan's son Col minding the forge, Mabry's apprentice Lorna minding the shop; Corwin took the smith's iron cart.

inn.speaker: Ossian
inn.text: Welcome, traveller! Come in, sit down! The Drowned Lantern's had no guests since Corwin started robbing the north road.

arms.speaker: Col
arms.text: Father's out, but I can sell you anything on the rack! Corwin took our iron cart, so this is all there is. What'll it be?

magic.speaker: Lorna
magic.text: Mabry's gone to her sister's, so I'm keeping the shop! Potions, scrolls, spell books... please don't ask me what they do!

variants.specifics: Hal at the Grey Goose by the ford, Dunstan, Mabry; the Ashwood wolves keep travellers off the roads at night.

inn.speaker: Hal
inn.text: The Grey Goose welcomes you, friend! Best beds by the ford. Stay off the Ashwood road at night -- the wolves are hungry!

arms.speaker: Dunstan
arms.text: Wolves, bandits, and who knows what else! You've come to the right man. Dunstan's blades are the sharpest in Brackenford!

magic.speaker: Mabry
magic.text: Welcome, Wanderer! Need a potion for the road? With wolves in the Ashwood, you'll want two or three!

variants.specifics: Ossian boasting of his ale, Ketter the armourer, Mabry; Corwin robbed the pedlars' carts on the north road.

inn.speaker: Ossian
inn.text: Welcome to the Drowned Lantern! The ale's as fresh as the river... well, fresher than the river, anyway! Sit down, sit down!

arms.speaker: Ketter
arms.text: Ketter's armoury! Corwin robbed the pedlars, so mine's the only steel for twenty miles. Look around, young sir!

magic.speaker: Mabry
magic.text: You're the first face I've seen all week! Potions, scrolls, spell books -- buy something, please! The bandits took my last order.

variants.specifics: Ossian, Dunstan and Mabry the morning after the barrow Urchins raided the shops by night.

inn.speaker: Ossian
inn.text: Hello, stranger! Hungry? We've bread and fish. The Urchins took the cheese last night -- dug right under the cellar wall!

arms.speaker: Dunstan
arms.text: The Urchins came for my tools last night, the little rats! What's left is for sale. Need a sword, lad?

magic.speaker: Mabry
magic.text: Shh! Come in quick and shut the door! The Urchins stole three potions off my sill. Do you want what's left?

variants.specifics: Marta, Ossian's wife, at the Drowned Lantern, Dunstan, Rook the travelling magic-seller; nothing comes from the north.

inn.speaker: Marta
inn.text: Ossian's out fishing, so it's me today! Welcome to the Drowned Lantern, kind sir. Rooms are cheap -- there's nobody else in them!

arms.speaker: Dunstan
arms.text: Hmmm. Strong arms on you. Dunstan can make them stronger -- with a good sword and a better shield! What do you need?

magic.speaker: Rook
magic.text: Rook's the name! Potions, scrolls and spell books, all the way from the south. Nobody comes from the north now, so I'm all you've got!

variants.specifics: Ossian, Brannoc the smith, Mabry; winter is near and no carts come down the north road.

inn.speaker: Ossian
inn.text: Welcome! Warm yourself by the fire, traveller. Winter's coming and no carts come down the north road. Will you stay the night?

arms.speaker: Brannoc
arms.text: Brannoc's forge! I've got swords and shields, but not much iron left. Better buy now, before the bandits get it all!

magic.speaker: Mabry
magic.text: Good day, friend! Potions to mend you, scrolls to guard you, books to teach you. Buy while I've still got stock!
